john.21.p1.b1.text: Later, by the Sea of Tiberias, Jesus again revealed Himself to the disciples.

john.21.p1.b4.text: So they went out and got into the boat, but caught nothing that night.

john.21.p2.b1.text: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not recognize that it was Jesus.

john.21.p2.b2.text: Children, do you have any fish?

john.21.p2.b3.text: Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.

john.21.p2.b4.text: So they cast it there, and they were unable to haul it in because of the great number of fish.

john.21.p3.b2.text: As soon as Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment (for he had removed it) and jumped into the sea.

john.21.p3.b3.text: The other disciples came ashore in the boat. They dragged in the net full of fish, for they were not far from land, only about a hundred yards.

john.21.p4.b1.text: When they landed, they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it, and some bread.

john.21.p4.b2.text: Bring some of the fish you have just caught.

john.21.p4.b3.text: It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many, the net was not torn.

john.21.p5.b2.text: None of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?” They knew it was the Lord.

john.21.p5.b3.text: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and He did the same with the fish.

john.21.p5.b4.text: This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead.

john.21.p6.b1.text: When they had finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter,

john.21.p6.b2.text: Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?

john.21.p6.b3.text: Yes, Lord, … You know I love You.

john.21.p7.b2.text: Simon son of John, do you love Me?

john.21.p7.b3.text: Yes, Lord, … You know I love You.

john.21.p8.b1.text: Simon son of John, do you love Me?

john.21.p8.b2.text: Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?”

john.21.p8.b3.text: Lord, You know all things, … You know I love You.

john.21.p9.b1.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted;

john.21.p9.b2.text: but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.

john.21.p9.b3.text: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. And after He had said this, He told him,

john.21.p10.b1.text: Peter turned and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them.

john.21.p10.b3.text: If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you? You follow Me!

john.21.p10.b4.text: Because of this, the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple would not die. However, Jesus did not say that he would not die, …

john.21.p11.b1.text: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who has written them down. And we know that his testimony is true.

john.21.p11.b2.text: There are many more things that Jesus did. If all of them were written down,

john.21.p11.b3.text: I suppose that not even the world itself would have space for the books that would be written.
